# CausalPy 1.1.0 release notes (draft)

This is the curated, human-written draft for the `v1.1.0` entry on the [GitHub releases](https://github.com/pymc-labs/CausalPy/releases) page. It is not part of the Sphinx docs build: paste it into the GitHub release when tagging, alongside the auto-generated commit-level notes.

## 1.1.0

### Breaking changes

#### `StateSpaceTimeSeries` is no longer experimental

`StateSpaceTimeSeries` is no longer experimental and no longer emits a `FutureWarning` on construction (`causalpy/pymc_models.py`; PR #1113). Code that suppressed or asserted on that warning needs updating. It also no longer prints the pymc-extras "Model Requirements" table when it builds, and it infers the frequency of a regularly spaced index, which removes the pymc-extras warning about a missing index frequency on every fit.

`BayesianBasisExpansionTimeSeries` is unchanged: it stays experimental and keeps its `FutureWarning`.

`StateSpaceTimeSeries` now raises `ValueError` when `seasonal_length` is not an integer of at least 2 and no custom `seasonality_component` is given, and when `level_order` is not an integer of at least 1 and no custom `trend_component` is given. Both previously reached `pymc-extras` and failed there with less direct errors; a float `seasonal_length` was accepted without complaint. NumPy integers are accepted and cast to `int`.

`StateSpaceTimeSeries.predict` now emits a `UserWarning` when the dates in `X` do not match the forecast index derived from the training frequency. Forecast values are relabeled onto the dates in `X` by position, as before; the warning only flags the mismatch.
